notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
Hey!
I added a main scene, nothing fancy but at least now the game has a proper entry point haha!

You can finally tweak sound and music settings! A small thing, but essential, right?

I also reworked the tutorial, it's a bit more guided now but hopefully that helps new players understand what's going on more easily!

Some new game rules too:
[list]
[*] Many buildings are now upgradable, no more mass clicking (but yeah, it costs gold 💰)
[*] Wheat is now treated like a real resource
[*] Houses consume wheat every turn. No free lunch!
[/list]

Overall, it should feel more solid and make more sense now.
More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bonus for widescreen displays is now properly centered.
[*] The Towers won't attack one time when moved
[*] Hover effect on tiles is smaller and less intrusive (especially for widescreen users).
[*] The mouse is now locked within the game window.
[*] Destroying a building refunds 100% of the resources if it was just placed (allowing for quick testing and adjustments).
[*] Pressing Escape stops camera movement.
[*] Fixed house info: houses now correctly provide only one colonist.
[*] Error and day information messages are now displayed higher on the screen.
[*] Added the number of days remaining until Swarm Day in the day message.
[/list]
Thank you all for your feedback and for playing the demo!
